args.title: Tamarack Components — Retail Returns Logistics Summary
args.body:
• Newsletter: Tamarack Components’ latest issue focuses on retail returns logistics and links to the main analysis plus a company-tailored companion piece.
• Main article: Apparel return rates reached 24%, while consolidated return hubs reduced handling costs by 20%.
• Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
